# ==============================================================================
# PFT4T::Pulmonary Function Test Calculator for Thai
# Converted from GLIPFT.qmd to standalone Shiny App (compatible with Shinylive)
# ==============================================================================

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(ggplot2)

# Ensure rspiro is available (for both local R and Shinylive webR runtime)
if (!requireNamespace("rspiro", quietly = TRUE)) {
  if (requireNamespace("webr", quietly = TRUE)) {
    webr::install("rspiro")
  }
}
library(rspiro)

# Load CSV reference tables
mFRC   <- read.csv("m_frc.csv")
fFRC   <- read.csv("f_frc.csv")
mTLC   <- read.csv("m_tlc.csv")
fTLC   <- read.csv("f_tlc.csv")
mIC    <- read.csv("m_ic.csv")
fIC    <- read.csv("f_ic.csv")
mRV    <- read.csv("m_rv.csv")
fRV    <- read.csv("f_rv.csv")
mRVTLC <- read.csv("m_rvtlc.csv")
fRVTLC <- read.csv("f_rvtlc.csv")
mDLCO  <- read.csv("m_dlco.csv")
fDLCO  <- read.csv("f_dlco.csv")
mKCO   <- read.csv("m_kco.csv")
fKCO   <- read.csv("f_kco.csv")
mVA    <- read.csv("m_va.csv")
fVA    <- read.csv("f_va.csv")

# Helper function for age rounding (to quarters of year)
R4 <- function(x) {
  y <- round(round(round(x * 40, digits = 0) / 10, digits = 0) / 4, digits = 2)
  return(y)
}

# ==============================================================================
# User Interface (UI)
# ==============================================================================

      inline = TRUE

      "Date of Test",
      format = "dd-mm-yyyy",
      value = Sys.Date()

    dateInput(

      "Date of Birth",

While the information is presented in good faith and believed to be accurate at the time of publication, no representation or warranty is made regarding its accuracy, completeness, or timeliness. Users are solely responsible for their own decisions and actions based on the information provided herein.")
          )

  ),
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Tab 2: Lung Volume Study & Diffusing Capacity
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  nav_panel(
    title = "Lung Volume Study & Diffusing Capacity",
    layout_columns(
      col_widths = c(12),
      card(
        card_header(
          class = "bg-primary text-white font-weight-bold",

            numericInput("m_tlc", "TLC (L)", value = 0, step = 0.01),

            numericInput("m_frc", "FRC (L)", value = 0, step = 0.01),

          ),
          layout_columns(
            col_widths = c(3, 3, 3, 3),
            numericInput("m_rvtlc", "RV/TLC (%)", value = 0, max = 100, step = 0.1),
            numericInput("m_dlco", "DLCO", value = 0, step = 0.1),
            numericInput("m_kco", "KCO", value = 0, step = 0.01),

        )
      ),
      card(
        card_header(
          class = "bg-primary text-white font-weight-bold",

        ),
        card_body(
          tags$div(
            class = "table-responsive",
            tags$table(
              class = "table table-striped table-hover align-middle",
              tags$thead(
                tags$tr(
                  tags$th(style = "color: #df691a; width: 25%;", "Parameter"),
                  tags$th(style = "color: #df691a; width: 15%;", "Measured"),
                  tags$th(style = "color: #df691a; width: 15%;", "Predicted"),
                  tags$th(style = "color: #df691a; width: 15%;", "% Predicted"),
                  tags$th(style = "color: #df691a; width: 15%;", "Corrected"),
                  tags$th(style = "color: #df691a; width: 15%;", "Z-score")
                )
              ),
              tags$tbody(
                tags$tr(
                  tags$td(tags$strong("TLC (L)")),
                  tags$td(textOutput("tlc_b", inline = TRUE)),
                  tags$td(textOutput("tlc_pred", inline = TRUE)),
                  tags$td(textOutput("tlc_pp", inline = TRUE)),
                  tags$td(textOutput("tlc_c", inline = TRUE)),
                  tags$td(textOutput("tlc_z", inline = TRUE))
                ),
                tags$tr(

                ),
                tags$tr(
                  tags$td(tags$strong("RV/TLC (%)")),

                  tags$td(textOutput("rvtlc_pp", inline = TRUE)),
                  tags$td(textOutput("rvtlc_c", inline = TRUE)),

      ),
      layout_columns(

# ==============================================================================
# Server Logic
# ==============================================================================
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Reactive calculated ages
  age_raw <- reactive({
    req(input$DOT, input$DOB)
    as.double(input$DOT - input$DOB) / 365.25
  })
  
  age_used <- reactive({
    R4(age_raw())
  })
  
  output$age <- renderText({
    round(age_raw(), digits = 2)
  })
  
  output$ageUsed <- renderText({
    age_used()
  })

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Spirometry Calculations
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## FVC
  output$fvc <- renderText({
    input$m_fvc
  })
  
  output$fvc_pred <- renderText({
    age2 <- age_used()
    round(pred_GLI(age2, input$ht / 100, input$sex, 4, param = "FVC"), digits = 3)
  })
  
  output$fvc_lln <- renderText({
    age2 <- age_used()
    round(LLN_GLI(age2, input$ht / 100, input$sex, 4, param = "FVC"), digits = 3)
  })
  
  output$fvc_pp <- renderText({
    age2 <- age_used()
    pctpred_FVC <- round(pctpred_GLI(age2, input$ht / 100, input$sex, 4, FVC = input$m_fvc), digits = 1)
    ifelse(input$m_fvc > 0, pctpred_FVC, NA)
  })
  
  output$fvc_z <- renderText({
    age2 <- age_used()
    fvc_z <- round(zscore_GLI(age2, input$ht / 100, input$sex, 4, FVC = input$m_fvc), digits = 4)
    ifelse(input$m_fvc > 0, fvc_z, NA)
  })

  ## FEV1
  output$fev1 <- renderText({
    input$m_fev1
  })
  
  output$fev1_pred <- renderText({
    age2 <- age_used()
    round(pred_GLI(age2, input$ht / 100, input$sex, 4, param = "FEV1"), digits = 3)
  })
  
  output$fev1_lln <- renderText({
    age2 <- age_used()
    round(LLN_GLI(age2, input$ht / 100, input$sex, 4, param = "FEV1"), digits = 3)
  })
  
  output$fev1_pp <- renderText({
    age2 <- age_used()
    fev1_pp <- round(pctpred_GLI(age2, input$ht / 100, input$sex, 4, FEV1 = input$m_fev1), digits = 1)
    ifelse(input$m_fev1 > 0, fev1_pp, NA)
  })
  
  output$fev1_z <- renderText({
    age2 <- age_used()
    fev1_z <- round(zscore_GLI(age2, input$ht / 100, input$sex, 4, FEV1 = input$m_fev1), digits = 4)
    ifelse(input$m_fev1 > 0, fev1_z, NA)
  })

  ## FEV1/FVC
  output$fevfvc <- renderText({
    input$m_fevfvc
  })
  
  output$fevfvc_pred <- renderText({
    age2 <- age_used()
    round(100 * pred_GLI(age2, input$ht / 100, input$sex, 4, param = "FEV1FVC"), digits = 1)
  })
  
  output$fevfvc_lln <- renderText({
    age2 <- age_used()
    round(100 * LLN_GLI(age2, input$ht / 100, input$sex, 4, param = "FEV1FVC"), digits = 1)
  })
  
  output$fevfvc_pp <- renderText({
    age2 <- age_used()
    fevfvc_pp <- round(pctpred_GLI(age2, input$ht / 100, input$sex, 4, FEV1FVC = input$m_fevfvc / 100), digits = 1)
    ifelse(input$m_fevfvc > 0, fevfvc_pp, NA)
  })
  
  output$fevfvc_z <- renderText({
    age2 <- age_used()
    fevfvc_z <- round(zscore_GLI(age2, input$ht / 100, input$sex, 4, FEV1FVC = input$m_fevfvc / 100), digits = 4)
    ifelse(input$m_fevfvc > 0, fevfvc_z, NA)
  })

  ## FEF25-75%
  output$fef <- renderText({
    input$m_fef
  })
  
  output$fef_pred <- renderText({
    age2 <- age_used()
    round(pred_GLI(age2, input$ht / 100, input$sex, 4, param = "FEF2575"), digits = 3)
  })
  
  output$fef_lln <- renderText({
    age2 <- age_used()
    round(LLN_GLI(age2, input$ht / 100, input$sex, 4, param = "FEF2575"), digits = 3)
  })
  
  output$fef_pp <- renderText({
    age2 <- age_used()
    fef_pp <- round(pctpred_GLI(age2, input$ht / 100, input$sex, 4, FEF2575 = input$m_fef), digits = 1)
    ifelse(input$m_fef > 0, fef_pp, NA)
  })
  
  output$fef_z <- renderText({
    age2 <- age_used()
    fef_z <- round(zscore_GLI(age2, input$ht / 100, input$sex, 4, FEF2575 = input$m_fef), digits = 4)
    ifelse(input$m_fef > 0, fef_z, NA)
  })

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lung Volume & Diffusing Capacity Calculations
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  output$tlc_b   <- renderText({ input$m_tlc })
  output$ic_b    <- renderText({ input$m_ic })
  output$frc_b   <- renderText({ input$m_frc })
  output$rv_b    <- renderText({ input$m_rv })
  output$rvtlc_b <- renderText({ input$m_rvtlc })
  output$dlco_b  <- renderText({ input$m_dlco })
  output$kco_b   <- renderText({ input$m_kco })
  output$va_b    <- renderText({ input$m_va })

  # Placeholder for columns without defined calculations
  output$ic_c    <- renderText({ "" })
  output$frc_c   <- renderText({ "" })
  output$rvtlc_c <- renderText({ "" })
  output$dlco_c  <- renderText({ "" })
  output$dlcoa_c <- renderText({ "" })
  output$kco_c   <- renderText({ "" })
  output$kcoa_c  <- renderText({ "" })
  output$va_c    <- renderText({ "" })

  ## TLC
  output$tlc_pred <- renderText({
    age3 <- age_used()
    sex2 <- as.numeric(input$sex)
    TLCm <- mTLC[mTLC$age == age3, ]
    TLCf <- fTLC[fTLC$age == age3, ]
    if (nrow(TLCm) == 0 || nrow(TLCf) == 0) return("NA")
    tlc_Msp <- TLCm$Mspline * abs(sex2 - 2) + TLCf$Mspline * abs(sex2 - 1)
    tlc_pred <- round(exp(-10.5861 + 0.1433 * log(age3) + 2.3155 * log(input$ht) + tlc_Msp), digits = 3) * abs(sex2 - 2) + 
                round(exp(-10.1128 + 0.1062 * log(age3) + 2.2259 * log(input$ht) + tlc_Msp), digits = 3) * abs(sex2 - 1)
    tlc_pred
  })
  
  output$tlc_pp <- renderText({
    age3 <- age_used()
    sex2 <- as.numeric(input$sex)
    TLCm <- mTLC[mTLC$age == age3, ]
    TLCf <- fTLC[fTLC$age == age3, ]
    if (nrow(TLCm) == 0 || nrow(TLCf) == 0) return("NA")
    tlc_Msp <- TLCm$Mspline * abs(sex2 - 2) + TLCf$Mspline * abs(sex2 - 1)
    tlc_pred <- exp(-10.5861 + 0.1433 * log(age3) + 2.3155 * log(input$ht) + tlc_Msp) * abs(sex2 - 2) + 
                exp(-10.1128 + 0.1062 * log(age3) + 2.2259 * log(input$ht) + tlc_Msp) * abs(sex2 - 1)
    round(input$m_tlc / tlc_pred * 100, digits = 1)
  })
  
  output$tlc_c <- renderText({
    age3 <- age_used()
    sex2 <- as.numeric(input$sex)
    TLCm <- mTLC[mTLC$age == age3, ]
    TLCf <- fTLC[fTLC$age == age3, ]
    if (nrow(TLCm) == 0 || nrow(TLCf) == 0) return("NA")
    tlc_Msp <- TLCm$Mspline * abs(sex2 - 2) + TLCf$Mspline * abs(sex2 - 1)
    tlc_pred <- exp(-10.5861 + 0.1433 * log(age3) + 2.3155 * log(input$ht) + tlc_Msp) * abs(sex2 - 2) + 
                exp(-10.1128 + 0.1062 * log(age3) + 2.2259 * log(input$ht) + tlc_Msp) * abs(sex2 - 1)
    tlc_pp <- input$m_tlc / tlc_pred * 100
    round(tlc_pp / 0.88, digits = 1)
  })
  
  output$tlc_z <- renderText({
    age3 <- age_used()
    sex2 <- as.numeric(input$sex)
    TLCm <- mTLC[mTLC$age == age3, ]
    TLCf <- fTLC[fTLC$age == age3, ]
    if (nrow(TLCm) == 0 || nrow(TLCf) == 0) return("NA")
    tlc_Msp <- TLCm$Mspline * abs(sex2 - 2) + TLCf$Mspline * abs(sex2 - 1)
    tlc_pred <- exp(-10.5861 + 0.1433 * log(age3) + 2.3155 * log(input$ht) + tlc_Msp) * abs(sex2 - 2) + 
                exp(-10.1128 + 0.1062 * log(age3) + 2.2259 * log(input$ht) + tlc_Msp) * abs(sex2 - 1)
    tlc_L <- 0.9337 * abs(sex2 - 2) + 0.4636 * abs(sex2 - 1)
    tlc_Ssp <- TLCm$Sspline * abs(sex2 - 2) + TLCf$Sspline * abs(sex2 - 1)
    tlc_S <- exp(-2.0616143 - 0.0008534 * age3 + tlc_Ssp) * abs(sex2 - 2) +
             exp(-2.0999321 + 0.0001564 * age3 + tlc_Ssp) * abs(sex2 - 1)
    tlc_bc <- input$m_tlc / 0.88
    tlc_z <- round((((tlc_bc / tlc_pred)^tlc_L) - 1) / (tlc_L * tlc_S), digits = 4)
    ifelse(input$m_tlc != 0, tlc_z, "NA")
  })

  ## IC
  output$ic_pred <- renderText({
    age3 <- age_used()
    sex2 <- as.numeric(input$sex)
    ICm <- mIC[mIC$age == age3, ]
    ICf <- fIC[fIC$age == age3, ]

    kcoa_pred <- exp(4.088408 - 0.415334 * log(input$ht) - 0.113166 * log(age3) + kco_Msp) * abs(sex2 - 2) +
                 exp(5.131492 - 0.645656 * log(input$ht) - 0.097395 * log(age3) + kco_Msp) * abs(sex2 - 1)
    ifelse(input$hb > 0, round((kcoa / kcoa_pred) * 100, digits = 1), "NA")
  })
  
  output$kcoa_z <- renderText({
    age3 <- age_used()
    sex2 <- as.numeric(input$sex)
    KCOm <- mKCO[mKCO$age == age3, ]
    KCOf <- fKCO[fKCO$age == age3, ]
    if (nrow(KCOm) == 0 || nrow(KCOf) == 0) return("NA")
    kco_Msp <- KCOm$Mspline * abs(sex2 - 2) + KCOf$Mspline * abs(sex2 - 1)
    kco_Ssp <- KCOm$Sspline * abs(sex2 - 2) + KCOf$Sspline * abs(sex2 - 1)
    kcoa_pred <- exp(4.088408 - 0.415334 * log(input$ht) - 0.113166 * log(age3) + kco_Msp) * abs(sex2 - 2) +
                 exp(5.131492 - 0.645656 * log(input$ht) - 0.097395 * log(age3) + kco_Msp) * abs(sex2 - 1)
    kco_S <- exp(-1.98186 + 0.01460 * log(age3) + kco_Ssp) * abs(sex2 - 2) +
             exp(-1.63787 - 0.07757 * log(age3) + kco_Ssp) * abs(sex2 - 1)
    kco_L <- 0.67330 * abs(sex2 - 2) + 0.48963 * abs(sex2 - 1)
    kcoa <- (input$m_kco * (input$hb + 10.22) / (1.7 * input$hb)) * abs(sex2 - 2) +
            (input$m_kco * (input$hb + 9.38) / (1.7 * input$hb)) * abs(sex2 - 1)
    kcoa_z <- (((kcoa / kcoa_pred)^kco_L) - 1) / (kco_L * kco_S)
    ifelse(input$m_kco != 0 && input$hb > 0, round(kcoa_z, digits = 4), "NA")
  })

  ## VA
  output$va_pred <- renderText({
    age3 <- age_used()
    sex2 <- as.numeric(input$sex)
    VAm <- mVA[mVA$age == age3, ]
    VAf <- fVA[fVA$age == age3, ]
    if (nrow(VAm) == 0 || nrow(VAf) == 0) return("NA")
    va_Msp <- VAm$Mspline * abs(sex2 - 2) + VAf$Mspline * abs(sex2 - 1)
    va_pred <- exp(-11.086573 + 2.430021 * log(input$ht) + 0.097047 * log(age3) + va_Msp) * abs(sex2 - 2) + 
               exp(-9.873970 + 2.182316 * log(input$ht) + 0.082868 * log(age3) + va_Msp) * abs(sex2 - 1)
    round(va_pred, digits = 3)
  })
  
  output$va_pp <- renderText({
    age3 <- age_used()
    sex2 <- as.numeric(input$sex)
    VAm <- mVA[mVA$age == age3, ]
    VAf <- fVA[fVA$age == age3, ]
    if (nrow(VAm) == 0 || nrow(VAf) == 0) return("NA")
    va_Msp <- VAm$Mspline * abs(sex2 - 2) + VAf$Mspline * abs(sex2 - 1)
    va_pred <- exp(-11.086573 + 2.430021 * log(input$ht) + 0.097047 * log(age3) + va_Msp) * abs(sex2 - 2) + 
               exp(-9.873970 + 2.182316 * log(input$ht) + 0.082868 * log(age3) + va_Msp) * abs(sex2 - 1)
    round((input$m_va / va_pred) * 100, digits = 1)
  })
  
  output$va_z <- renderText({
    age3 <- age_used()
    sex2 <- as.numeric(input$sex)
    VAm <- mVA[mVA$age == age3, ]
    VAf <- fVA[fVA$age == age3, ]
    if (nrow(VAm) == 0 || nrow(VAf) == 0) return("NA")
    va_Msp <- VAm$Mspline * abs(sex2 - 2) + VAf$Mspline * abs(sex2 - 1)
    va_Ssp <- VAm$Sspline * abs(sex2 - 2) + VAf$Sspline * abs(sex2 - 1)
    va_pred <- exp(-11.086573 + 2.430021 * log(input$ht) + 0.097047 * log(age3) + va_Msp) * abs(sex2 - 2) + 
               exp(-9.873970 + 2.182316 * log(input$ht) + 0.082868 * log(age3) + va_Msp) * abs(sex2 - 1)
    va_S <- exp(-2.20953 + 0.01937 * log(age3) + va_Ssp) * abs(sex2 - 2) +
            exp(-2.08839 - 0.01334 * log(age3) + va_Ssp) * abs(sex2 - 1)
    va_L <- 0.62559 * abs(sex2 - 2) + 0.51919 * abs(sex2 - 1)
    va_z <- round(((input$m_va / va_pred)^va_L - 1) / (va_L * va_S), digits = 4)
    ifelse(input$m_va != 0, va_z, "NA")
  })
}
